_meta.title: H3 All-in-One — single-pass (T2V / I2V / FL)
_meta.note: API-format graph. Drag onto the ComfyUI canvas (0.31.0 will offer to import it) or use Workflow > Open. Started as a rebuild of the Prompt Mastery 'All-in-One MiniMax H3 Workflow — Best for Action Shots' video's two-stage sigma-split + latent-upscale pipeline. That path RAN but produced checkerboard/color-patch corruption traced to feeding the 4-step-distilled turbo LoRA a naive BasicScheduler(8)->SplitSigmas(4) schedule it wasn't trained for (confirmed: decoding stage 1 alone, before the upscaler, was already pure checkerboard — the trained MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D node itself was innocent). Reverted to this single-pass form on 2026-09-01, matching the proven-good H3 recipe used everywhere else this session (SamplerCustomAdvanced, one full 8-step schedule, no split, decode straight off the raw AV latent — no LTXVSeparateAVLatent/Concat needed without an upscale stage in between). See the .md next to this file for the full corruption writeup and the latent-upscaler/dual-clock-sampler research if you want to revisit the two-stage path later.
_meta.t2v_vs_i2v: As wired = I2V/FL (node 11 LoadImage -> node 12 resize -> node 20 first_frame). For pure T2V: delete the link into node 20 'first_frame'. For first+last-frame: add a second LoadImage+ImageResizeKJv2 into node 20 'last_frame'.

inputs.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: Cinematic live-action, handheld, golden-hour rooftop chase. A lean free-runner in a grey hoodie and black joggers sprints straight toward camera across a gravel rooftop, arms pumping, breath visible. At 00:03 he plants one foot on a low air-conditioning unit and vaults it without breaking stride. At 00:06 he reaches the roof edge and launches into a full running jump over a two-metre gap, hoodie snapping, gravel spraying from the take-off foot. At 00:09 he lands hard on the next roof in a low shoulder-to-hip roll and comes straight back up running. At 00:12 he cuts hard left around a brick stairwell housing, one hand dragging along the wall, and accelerates away toward a water tower. The camera runs with him the whole time, whip-adjusting to keep him centre frame, slight motion blur, a lens flare as he crosses the sun. overall_soundscape: pounding footfalls on gravel and tar, fast ragged breathing, hoodie fabric snapping, distant city hum, wind buffeting the mic on the jump, a heavy scuffing thud on the landing roll. non_diegetic_music: a driving low synth pulse with a fast ticking hi-hat, rising through the vault, dropping to sub-bass and a single heartbeat at the apex of the jump, slamming back in on the landing.
